rule: Scenes are indexed authoring views over stable regions/partitions of the same persistent world authority.

stableRegionIdentity.legacyAdapter: Scene rectangle assignments derive the same stable region identity from world seed + landmass/grid position; no new authored Scene should depend on preview pixels as identity.
stableRegionIdentity.offWorldRule: Interiors/caves without an overworld grid location keep a stable ProjectSceneId and are explicitly off-world rather than receiving fabricated coordinates.
